title: REQ · Cleanup untracks the conflicted vitest results.json and clears its index entry
summary: untrackNodeModules force-removes the conflicted cache file from the index.
description: Context: untrackNodeModules runs 'git rm --cached --ignore-unmatch -q' on the results.json path, which git refuses for an entry with unmerged state unless forced. Desired behavior: use -f so conflict stages 1-3 are cleared and the path is untracked while kept on disk. Why: the cache file is tracked and conflicted and must leave the index.
acceptance_criteria: Given a fake runner, when untrackNodeModules runs, then a call 'rm --cached -f --ignore-unmatch -q -- node_modules/.vite/vitest/results.json' is made.
Given the same run, then the node_modules directory removal call is still made first and no call lacks --cached.

out_of_scope: Running the cleanup against the real repo from a test

technical_constraints: Git is only reached through the injected GitRunner
definition_of_done: Force cached removal of results.json is issued
